body:
# **CosmicSMP Plugin**
### ⚡ *A Next-Gen Identity Steal SMP Experience* ⚡

# **Dependences For This Plugin**
- [ProtocolLib Plugin](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/protocollib.1997/)
- [LibsDisguises Plugin](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/libs-disguises-free.81/)
- [PacketsEvent Plugin](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/packetevents-api.80279/)

Type **/help** To Know Commands :)
 
## 💀 **What is CosmicSMP?**

**CosmicSMP** is not just a plugin… it’s a **complete gameplay system** that transforms your Minecraft server into a **high-stakes, identity-based survival experience**.

Every fight matters. Every player could be someone else.
**Trust no one. Become anyone.**

---

## ✨ **🔥 Core Features**

---

### 🔐 **1. Cosmic Entry System**

* Players join → instantly **locked & blinded** 👁️‍🗨️
* Cannot move until verified
* Must type a secret code in chat:

  * ✅ Correct → Access granted
  * ❌ Wrong → Can,t Play

💡 Adds **security + cinematic entry feel**

---

### 🌌 **2. Cosmic Mode System**

Two powerful states control the server:

#### ⚔️ Active Cosmic Mode

* PvP ENABLED
* Identity stealing ENABLED
* Chaos begins 💀

#### 🛡️ Inactive Cosmic Mode

* PvP DISABLED (players only)
* Mobs still attack normally

📢 Mode changes show:

* 🎬 Title on screen
* 💬 Chat broadcast

---

### 💀 **3. Identity Steal System (MAIN FEATURE)**

When Cosmic Mode is active and a player gets a kill:

* 🎯 Victim’s identity is captured
* ⏳ No instant transformation

#### 👁️ Use `/see`:

* View collected identities
* Select any player you killed

#### 🎭 On selection:

* 🧑‍🎨 Player skin changes
* 🏷️ Fake nametag applied
* 🧠 Full identity illusion

🔥 You literally **become that player**

---

### 🔁 **4. Revert System**

* Use `/see` again
* Return to your **original identity**
`Make Sure After Then Rejoin Your Server`

✔ Smooth switching
✔ No bugs
✔ Instant revert

---

### ⚔️ **5. Smart PvP Control**

* 🟢 PvP ON → only during Cosmic Mode
* 🔴 PvP OFF → when Cosmic disabled
* 👹 Mobs always active

💡 Balanced gameplay — no boring downtime

---

### 🎬 **6. Immersive Effects**

* 🌟 Screen titles
* 💬 Clean chat messages
* ⚡ Smooth identity transitions
* 🎭 Real disguise feeling

---

## 🧠 **Gameplay Concept**

This plugin creates a **zero-trust environment**:

* Anyone can be anyone 👀
* Your enemy might be your friend… or vice versa
* Kills = power 💀
* Identity = weapon ⚔️

🔥 Perfect for **mind games, trolling, and strategy**

---

## 🎯 **Perfect For**

* 🟢 SMP Servers
* 🎥 YouTubers / Content Creators
* 🎭 Roleplay Servers
* ⚡ Hardcore Survival

---

## 🏁 **Summary**

> CosmicSMP is not just a plugin…
> It’s a **completely new way to play Minecraft**.

🌌 Identity System
⚔️ Controlled PvP
🎭 Real Disguises
🧠 Strategic Gameplay

💀 Every encounter becomes **unpredictable**

---

## 🚀 **Final Tagline**

**Steal. Survive. Deceive. Become Cosmic.** 🌌🔥
